how-24-02-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the block, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-24-02-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the block, then tap three things you notice.

how-24-02-compare.page: Put the lamp under one tray and the water under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.
how-24-02-compare.say: Put the lamp under one tray and the water under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.

how-24-02-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.
how-24-02-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.

how-24-02-det.page: Pick 3 actions, one at a time. Tap a clue, then pick its kind. Predict who it helps most, and watch the place appear.
how-24-02-det.say: Pick three actions, one at a time. Tap a clue, then pick its kind. Predict who it helps most, and watch the place appear.

how-24-02-partc.page: Draw one conservation action and what it does for the environment. Label the action and the resource it protects, and one living thing that benefits.
how-24-02-partc.say: Draw one conservation action and what it does for the environment. Label the action and the resource it protects, and one living thing that benefits.
